Are you a sales-driven professional who knows how to open doors, enjoys negotiating, and thrives in a technical B2B environment? Do you also have experience in the data center industry? Then this could be an exciting opportunity for you.For an internationally active company specialising in chemical solutions, we are looking for an International Business Development Manager to further develop its presence in the European data center market.You will join a financially strong organisation with international operations, its own R&D department, and a specialised product portfolio. At the same time, you will be part of a relatively small team where initiative, collaboration, and a hands-on approach are highly valued.What will you be doing?Data centers are becoming increasingly powerful, generating more and more heat in the process. To keep their infrastructure running reliably, they require specialised cooling solutions.Your role will be to identify commercial opportunities in this rapidly growing market and turn them into long-term customer relationships and successful business deals.More specifically, your responsibilities will include: 
• You will map the European data center market, identify business opportunities, and actively prospect for new customers. 
• You will establish relationships with data center operators, technical decision-makers, engineering companies, and other relevant industry players. 
• You will manage the entire sales process, from initial contact and negotiations through to securing commercial agreements. 
• You will develop long-term partnerships with existing customers and strategic business partners. 
• You will gain a thorough understanding of customers' technical requirements and work closely with internal specialists to propose suitable cooling solutions. 
• You will monitor market developments and translate your insights into targeted sales initiatives and concrete growth plans. 
• You will regularly liaise with colleagues in Asia and work closely with R&D, product management, marketing, and supply chain teams. 
• You will represent the company at international trade fairs, networking events, and industry meetings within the data center sector. 
• You will collaborate with another Business Development Manager, with customer segments divided between the two roles. You will report directly to the Business Manager.
We are not looking for a traditional Account Manager who mainly focuses on managing existing customers. We are looking for an experienced sales professional who enjoys developing new business, has a solid technical understanding, and knows how to turn commercial opportunities into tangible results.You recognise yourself in the following profile: 
• You have several years of experience in international B2B sales, business development, or strategic account management. 
• Ideally, you already have commercial experience in the data center industry and have built a relevant professional network. 
• You have a technical or chemical background, or at least a strong affinity for chemical products and technical applications. 
• You are a true sales hunter: prospecting, making new connections, and negotiating deals are what drive you. 
• You combine a strong commercial mindset with strategic thinking and a structured approach. 
• You are comfortable managing long sales cycles and building relationships with multiple decision-makers. 
• You have excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of another European language is an advantage. 
• You preferably hold a master's degree, combined with relevant professional experience. 
• You are willing to travel regularly, mainly within Europe. 
• You are preferably based in Belgium, although strong candidates based in Germany or France will also be considered.

Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés. Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.Safran Aircraft Engines conçoit, produit et commercialise, seul ou en coopération, des moteurs aéronautiques civils et militaires aux meilleurs niveaux de performance, fiabilité et respect de l'environnement. La société est notamment, à travers CFM International*, le leader mondial de la propulsion d'avions commerciaux courts et moyen-courriers.* CFM International est une société commune 50/50 de Safran Aircraft Engines et GE Aerospace.Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.We are looking for an Inspector (Jet Engines) to join and strengthen our teams.Your RoleAs an Aircraft Engine Inspector, you play a key role in ensuring quality, safety and airworthiness. Your work directly impacts aircraft performance and passenger safety.Your responsibilities include:

• Performing visual and dimensional inspections on dismantled engine parts following approved procedures
• Evaluating parts, modules or engines (serviceable, repairable or scrap) and recording decisions in the ERP system
• Launching and following up required actions based on inspection findings
• Using the appropriate tools, materials and inspection methods
• Ensuring full traceability by correctly closing inspection tasks
• Defining the future configuration of parts and modules
• Carrying out incoming inspections after repair or purchase
• Performing final inspections after internal repairs

Your ProfileWe are looking for inspectors who take pride in being quality driven, technically strong and comfortable taking responsibility.You bring:

• Technical high school diploma in mechanics, aeronautics or a related field
• Demonstrated experience as an Inspector with solid knowledge of aircraft engines
• A strong focus on quality, safety and compliance
• The ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure
• Flexibility and adaptability in changing working conditions
• A proactive mindset and sound decision making skills
• Excellent technical English; Dutch and/or French
• Willingness to work in a two shift system (06:00-14:00 / 14:00-22:00)
• The ability to thrive in an international, multicultural team
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

European HQ Brussels | CNC Machine Expertise | Technical Sales Support | European Scope | International Environment | Permanent Contract

 
About The Organisation This international machine tool manufacturer is a market leader in CNC machine tools across the Western world. Its product portfolio includes CNC machining centres, lathes, fiber lasers and press brakes.
 The organisation works with a network of dedicated distributors across different European countries. These local partners are responsible for selling and supporting the machines within their respective markets.

 To further strengthen its European sales activities, the company is looking for a Product Specialist who combines technical CNC expertise with strong commercial awareness. Depending on the candidate's background, the role can have a broader focus on CNC machines or a more specialised focus on fiber laser and press brake solutions.

 You will join a small, approachable and international team at the European headquarters in Brussels. The working environment offers considerable autonomy, short communication lines and regular collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders throughout Europe.

 
 
What will you do?Technical sales and pre-sales support

• Provide technical support to European distributors, Sales Managers and Sales Engineers.
• Advise on CNC machines, options, applications and configurations.
• Translate customer requirements into suitable technical solutions.
• Support sales teams throughout the commercial process, including product positioning, promotions and special pricing requests.
• Resolve technical or commercial issues that could delay a sale.
Relationship building and commercial insight

• Build strong relationships with distributors and local sales teams.
• Maintain regular contact to understand market needs, challenges and opportunities.
• Identify sales blockers, risks and potential business opportunities.
• Gather field feedback and translate it into actionable commercial insights.
• Share relevant market intelligence with the Sales Manager and internal teams.
Cross-functional coordination

• Collaborate with Sales, Applications, Service, Logistics, Marketing, IT and Product Management.
• Coordinate and follow up on cross-functional issues until resolution.
• Maintain regular contact with international colleagues and stakeholders.
• Support new product launches across Europe.
Training, demonstrations and customer visits

• Deliver product and application training to distributors and sales teams.
• Demonstrate CNC machines at customer sites, events and trade fairs.
• Support and coordinate customer and distributor visits to the European headquarters and showroom.
• Ensure machines, tooling and materials are ready for demonstrations.
• Support the coordination and smooth operation of the showroom.
Reporting and independent working

• Work autonomously and organise activities independently.
• Provide structured weekly reporting to the Sales Manager.
• Report and escalate sales blockers, missed opportunities and critical issues.
• Keep internal stakeholders informed about relevant customer and market developments.
 

What do you need?
Essential
• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in electromechanics, industrial engineering or another technical field.
• Equivalent technical expertise gained through professional experience can also be considered.
• At least approximately five years of relevant experience in a CNC, machining, manufacturing, engineering, product management or technical-commercial environment.
• Practical knowledge of CNC machines or experience working in a production environment.
• Experience with machining centres, lathes, fiber lasers or press brakes is a strong advantage.
• The ability to understand technical challenges and translate them into practical solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience supporting sales teams, customers, distributors or other commercial stakeholders.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly to different audiences.
• A customer-focused and commercially minded approach.
• Experience coordinating projects or working with different internal and external stakeholders.
• A structured way of working with attention to quality and detail.
• Fluent Dutch or French, combined with fluent English.
• Willingness to travel approximately one week per month within Europe.
• The ability to work independently and confidently in an international environment.
• A good working knowledge of Microsoft Office. Experience with SAP is an advantage.Your strengthsYou are technically strong, communicative and commercially aware. You enjoy solving technical problems, but you also understand the urgency and business impact behind a sales opportunity.You are comfortable taking ownership, coordinating different stakeholders and following issues through until they are resolved. As you will regularly work independently and travel throughout Europe, you can structure your own activities and make well-considered decisions. You are also:
• Mature and confident in your communication
• Hands-on and solution-oriented
• Proactive and responsive
• Customer-focused
• Commercially minded
• Structured and detail-oriented
• Comfortable working autonomously
• Capable of building trusted professional relationships
• Eager to deepen your knowledge of CNC machine technologies
• Able to remain calm and effective when priorities change or rapid action is required

jobs.description:
The job holder maintains budgets for all FAA lines of business in Brussels and FAA Representative offices located in Paris, Abu Dhabi, Dakar, Warsaw, and London. The budget management function includes expenditure forecasting, multi-year budget estimation, yearly travel budget development, expenditure tracking including travel burn rates, budget reconciliation, approval of payments, and submission of quarterly and close-out reports.
 
EDUCATION (multiple options): 2 years of University studies in any field or university degree in finance, accounting, business administration

EXPERIENCE: 2-5 years in finance, accounting, or business administration.

LANGUAGE: Fluency in English, French and Dutch.
 
Dynamic and multi-cultural work environment.

Full-time position with extra-legal benefits: life insurance, hospitalization insurance (family included), meal tickets, transportation reimbursements, seniority leave, special holidays, training, Employee Assistance Program, etc.

Salary as of €4.466 gross/month.

You develop our presence in Flanders among professional advisors: accounting firms (10+ people), notaries, family offices and independent wealth advisors. Your job is to understand how these firms work with their private clients, identify where wealth planning creates value for them, and show how we help them deliver it.

This is consultative selling. Sales cycles typically run from 5 to 9 months, and up to 18 months with larger organisations. Your credibility with partners and senior advisors rests first on your understanding of their profession and of private wealth matters. Sales technique comes second.

We're a technology provider. Your role is to understand advisors' needs and the wealth issues they handle, not to advise their end clients.
What you will do
Prospecting and discovery

• Work from an existing, qualified target list of firms and decision-makers in Flanders
• Lead in-depth discovery conversations with partners to understand their practice, their clients' wealth issues and their growth ambition.
• Translate these needs into concrete use cases for our company.
Advising and convincing

• Discuss succession, gifting and wealth structuring topics with advisors on an equal footing, and connect them to what the platform does
• Run tailored demos built around realistic client situations
